rule: Every OpenStreetMap way tagged highway=motorway is snapped to hex links exactly as the expressways of infrastructure.json. A way's opening year is, in this order: (osm) the year in its opening_date tag, else in its start_date tag (on highways: the date it opened); (wikidata) the year of P1619 (date of official opening) of the Wikidata item in its wikidata tag, or, for a way without a wikidata tag, of a Vietnamese expressway item whose Vietnamese label ("Đường cao tốc …") is the way's name (ignoring case and dash style), used only when all such dates agree on the year (bridge names are not matched: many small bridges share a famous bridge's name); inception (P571) and start time (P580) are not used; (viwiki) else the year from a reviewed table of Vietnamese Wikipedia quotes for the way's route name (see routes: when the whole named route/section was open to traffic, i.e. its last stage; for a road first opened as a pre-expressway, its first opening; one exception beats the OSM tag: La Sơn – Hòa Liên, whose OSM opening_date 2026-06-30 is the planned widening, not the 2022 opening); (name) else the year of the other ways with exactly the same name, used only when all of them agree; else unknown. A link's year is the earliest year among the ways crossing it; null if none.
note: OpenStreetMap maps only what is open as an expressway now, so expressways that were closed or are still being built are not here. Years come from mappers' opening_date/start_date tags, Wikidata P1619 and quoted Vietnamese Wikipedia sentences (CC BY-SA 4.0); a route opened in stages shows from its last stage, so its first sections appear later than they opened; links with an unknown year (null) stay drawn in every year, as on today's map. A name shared by a whole route can spread one section's year to sections that opened later in the same route.
